$comment: scripts/check-brand.mjs. Text is normalised first (NFKD, marks and zero-width characters removed, HTML entities and \u escapes decoded), then matched line by line. 'hard' fails the check; 'warn' prints a warning. The competitor's name is never written out here: the patterns spell it as character classes, and the tests encode their fixtures.

hard.note: The denylisted wearable brand, any case, with leetspeak and look-alike letters (also inside longer words: flagged on purpose, health copy has no reason to use it).
The same name with one repeated separator between every letter (spaces, dots, dashes, underscores).

warn.pattern: \b(?i:(?:better|cheaper|more accurate|smarter) than|compared (?:to|with)|unlike|besser als|günstiger als|genauer als|im vergleich (?:zu|mit)|anders als) \p{Lu}

warn.note: No competitor comparisons: 'unlike other trackers', 'anders als andere …'.
No subscription-pricing jabs. 'No subscription' as a plain fact is fine.
Feature names from another wearable brand's product vocabulary. Use RYFT's own words.
warn.pattern: \b(?:strain coach|sleep coach|stress monitor|health monitor|strength trainer|health ?span|pace of aging)\b

warn.note: '<Brand> Age' feature names. 'RYFT Age' only once the roadmap ships it.
